# @paladini/lattes-parser

> Independent open-source toolkit to edit Brazilian Plataforma Lattes curriculum XML locally (CLI/TypeScript), with automatic backups. Export and import on the CNPq platform remain manual. Not affiliated with CNPq.

## Primary workflow

1. User exports Currículo Lattes XML from the platform (logged in).
2. User edits locally: CLI (`lattes-parser set`) or TypeScript (`writeCurriculum`).
3. User re-imports the updated XML via "Importar XML" on the platform, reviews, and saves.

## Key facts

- Package: `@paladini/lattes-parser` on npm
- Docs: https://paladini.github.io/lattes-parser/
- Repo: https://github.com/paladini/lattes-parser
- Does NOT automate login, CAPTCHA, public scraping, or upload to CNPq

## Documentation map

- /ciclo-de-trabalho — step-by-step workflow
- /importacao-lattes — platform import expectations (merge behavior)
- /faq — common questions
- /cli — CLI reference
- /api-typescript — Node.js API
- /backups — .lattes-backup snapshots

## Install

npm install @paladini/lattes-parser
